founded.text: 5 June 1899 in Amsterdam, as the Nederlandsche Lawn Tennis Bond

headquarters.text: Nationaal Tennis Centrum, Bovenkerkerweg 81, Amstelveen, Netherlands

set.summary: The Netherlands' national tennis federation, which also governs padel, pickleball and beach tennis. Founded in Amsterdam in 1899, it has represented padel since 2016 and took over all padel activity when the Nederlandse Padelbond merged into it on 1 July 2020.

nameChange.editorNote: Not verified on 2026-10-25: the history page gives the founding name but not the date the royal title (Koninklijke) was granted.

set.name: Koninklijke Nederlandse Lawn Tennis Bond
